scope: Bounded read-only R2 review of the current isolated source-publication implementation. The review covered the retained publication tree, registration proof binding, staged digest checks, typed source-state collector, shared transaction helper, contract registration, focused tests, and the pinned inspector boundary. No production Vault, Git, network, operator, or human-gate mutation was performed.

historical_r1_review.note: The two R1 blockers are preserved as immutable history; this R2 review independently checks their fixes.

resolved_r1_findings.evidence: validate_registration now validates both child authorities and invokes markdown_source._capture_proof with the retained vault_after mode. _capture_proof binds the capture transaction operation type, exact business write, expected absence, empty reads/claims, exact before/after descriptors, and detached inspected transaction. The independent cross-pair and wrong-mode probes both reject the tampered registrations.

PublicationTree.install validates bounded bytes, total/file limits, lowercase digest-key grammar, and sha(value)==key before bind or atomic installation. The independent bad-digest probe returns SOURCE_PUBLICATION_INVALID and verifies that no invalid content file remains; valid installation still succeeds.

positive_checks.evidence: The source-publication authority and shared transaction helper require operation_type=ingest for transaction, receipt, staging, and upstream layers; registration has one claimed raw input and knowledge has none.
Dispatch and typed-state comparison use the fully qualified assessment-heads and source-display-heads paths; root-level records aliases are outside kind_for_path and writable authority.

The four schema resources are registered and closed. Request/proposal payload paths, digest-named content slots, canonical JSON, sorted uniqueness, declared limits, and kind/registration unions are checked.

PublicationTree retains directory/file descriptors before parsing, rejects unknown entries, links, unsafe entries and replacement, verifies complete content sets, and runs named-lineage checks on success and exception paths.

collect_source_state validates semantic namespaces, receipt-backed historical snapshots, ownership, locators, associations, decisions, derived heads, compiler output, and immutable history from one audited snapshot plus exact overlay.

The publication helper receives already validated bytes, claims, read preconditions, retained snapshot/session and operation identity, and the source inspector independently compares business and complete read sets before authority validation.
contracts.py dispatches source-publication request, authority, proposal, and assessment-heads documents through the source-publication contract checks.

checks: staging_bad_digest PASS SOURCE_PUBLICATION_INVALID; no invalid file remained

verification.transient_observation: An earlier concurrent run reported one upstream provenance refusal while the root worktree was changing; the selected test passed in isolation and the final focused run passed all 144 tests. This observation is retained as a limitation, not relabelled as a source finding.

limitations: The reviewed source worktree changed during the review; all final hashes above were captured after the final dynamic probe and 144-test run, but no Git commit or immutable source snapshot was created by this review.
No remote CI, installed-wheel parity, real Vault, vpwiki-admin, operator apply, merge, or human acceptance was performed.
implementation_gate: GO for root local acceptance of this reviewed snapshot. Fresh exact-head CI and all operator, real-data, and human gates remain separate.
